attacker_feedback: calibration scalar losses of past defender mixtures
mixture_interpretation: expected reset-episode outcomes of complete policies
interval_interpretation: paired held-out simulator seeds, conditional on calibrated policies and each fixed path; calibration uncertainty excluded

blue_policy_descriptions.decoy_cycle: Cycle eight official decoy types over four critical hosts; no restores.
blue_policy_descriptions.critical_restore: Restore Op_Server0 and Enterprise2 alternately every third step; monitor otherwise.
blue_policy_descriptions.decoy_react: Restore hosts with a PID in the latest Blue observation, with a three-step host cooldown; deploy cyclic decoys otherwise.

calibration_provenance.loss_unit: native negative reward converted to positive loss, averaged per simulator step
calibration_provenance.normalization: Euclidean norm of a priori scenario component bounds; independent of train/test observations
calibration_provenance.impact_definition: Penalty on each step while OTService is absent; it persists until restoration.
calibration_provenance.restore_definition: Negative executed Restore action cost, including failed Restore; no other Blue action costs accepted.
calibration_provenance.tensor_estimation: Only calibration means define the finite game. Held-out episodes never change the tensor, response map, menu, weights, or normalization.
calibration_provenance.uncertainty: Independent seed episodes; sample standard deviation and standard error per cell; common seed indices support paired downstream differences.
